overview: Euclid DR1 papers report CNN strong-lens detection and transformer segmentation; cosmology uses Gaussian-process and neural emulators; unsupervised learning classifies FRBs and IllustrisTNG galaxies; simulation-based inference and neural surrogates model chemical evolution and supernova equations of state.
themes: Cosmological emulators for LSST and modified gravity
Unsupervised classification of FRBs and galaxy formation pathways
Simulation-based inference and neural equation-of-state surrogates
Neural stellar spectroscopy and spectral models
